findings.title: Drag-to-the-ends reset needs the last 2.5 px of the bar
findings.detail: With the button gone, resetting means dragging each handle to exactly 1.0 / 0.0. DraggableBar rounds to 1/20 steps and only updates targetValue while Mouse.IsOver(barRect), so on the 100 px bar 'no cap' needs the pointer within 2.5 px of xMax (and 'none' within 2.5 px of x). A fast drag that leaves the bar early stops at 95% / 5%. The 'no cap'/'none' bar text does confirm success, and vanilla's psyfocus target behaves the same, so this is worth knowing rather than fixing.
